headline: GUYANA GOLD HUB VOTE IN HOURS: G2 SHAREHOLDERS DECIDE TOMORROW ON GMIN MERGER — ISS AND GLASS LEWIS BOTH RECOMMEND FOR AT 72% PREMIUM
source_name: GlobeNewswire / G2 Goldfields Inc. (TSX: G2) + G Mining Ventures Corp. (TSX: GMIN)
snippet: G2 Goldfields' special shareholder meeting is Tuesday June 16 at 10 AM Toronto time to vote on the plan of arrangement with G Mining Ventures Corp. (TSX: GMIN) — both leading proxy advisory firms, ISS and Glass Lewis, have issued FOR recommendations. Under the deal, each G2 share receives 0.212 GMIN shares plus 0.5 shares of a new exploration vehicle (G3 Goldfields) retaining G2's earlier-stage Guyana assets, implying a 72% premium based on 30-day VWAPs as of April 8, 2026. The transaction consolidates two adjacent Guyana gold projects — G Mining's fully permitted, fully financed Oko West and G2's Oko-Ghanie — into a single complex with LOM average annual gold production potential above 500,000 ounces, unlocking over C$1 billion in quantifiable synergies through shared infrastructure, mine sequencing, and throughput expansion that cannot be captured if the projects are developed independently. For TSXV and junior mining investors watching the mid-tier gold consolidation wave, the G2/GMIN deal adds Guyana to the list of tier-one gold jurisdictions being systematically consolidated by well-funded mid-tier producers flush with record free cash flow at $4,000+/oz operating gold prices — joining Agnico Eagle's Finland sweep and Coeur Mining's Canadian consolidation as defining M&A patterns of the current bull cycle.

headline: ENERGY FUELS WHITE MESA URANIUM MILL HITS FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE BY JUNE 30 — 1.6M lbs U3O8 FROM PINYON PLAIN AND LA SAL AT MIDYEAR
source_name: Mining.com / Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: EFTS; TSX: EFR)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: EFTS; TSX: EFR) announced June 11, 2026 that its White Mesa Mill in Utah — the only fully licensed and operational conventional uranium mill in the United States — expects approximately 1.6 million pounds of U3O8 production by June 30, meeting the low end of its full-year 2026 guidance range of 1.5–2.5 million pounds at the mid-year mark, fed by two conventional mines: Pinyon Plain (Arizona) and La Sal Complex (Utah). Following completion of the current processing campaign, the mill will pause to rebuild ore stockpiles before resuming operations in Q4 2026, subject to continued strong ore grades at the supplying mines. At $85–86/lb spot uranium — stable on the week despite muted spot activity — Energy Fuels' combination of operating conventional mines, the only US conventional milling capability, and a strong Q1 2026 production trajectory positions the company precisely in the supply chain niche that the pending 2028 Russian uranium import ban and accelerating utility long-term contracting are designed to fill with domestic US production. For TSX and TSXV uranium development investors, the White Mesa mid-year production milestone is a concrete data point confirming that the US conventional uranium supply chain is functioning — an operational validation that underpins the structural bull thesis for the sector regardless of near-term spot price consolidation at $85/lb.

headline: DAKOTA GOLD RICHMOND HILL STEP-OUT HITS 5.24 g/t Au OVER 13.5m — SOUTH DAKOTA PFS ON TRACK FOR LATE 2026 AS 94% OF DRILL PROGRAM COMPLETE
source_name: Investing News Network / Dakota Gold Corp. (NYSE American: DC)
snippet: Dakota Gold Corp. (NYSE American: DC) released June 11, 2026 additional assay results from the 2026 expansion campaign at Richmond Hill — a historically producing oxide heap-leach gold project in South Dakota — with hole RH26C-417 returning 13.5 metres at 5.24 g/t gold and 4.43 g/t silver from 110 metres depth, drilled north of the existing resource boundary, and hole RH26C-418 intersecting 21 metres at 3.33 g/t gold from 130 metres. With 94% of the 17,273-metre, 112-hole 2026 campaign now complete, systematic expansion holes are confirming gold-bearing mineralization extends beyond the current resource model in the northern portion of the deposit — the specific technical deliverable that defines the scope of a pre-feasibility study targeting late 2026. Richmond Hill produced over 350,000 ounces of gold via heap-leach processing from 1986–2001; its oxide mineralisation is amenable to the low-capital, low-operating-cost heap-leach processing method that generates positive project economics at gold prices well below the current $4,200+/oz — making the late-2026 PFS a potentially transformative valuation catalyst for a company whose resource base continues to grow with every new assay batch.

headline: GALWAY METALS CLARENCE STREAM: 34 HOLES CONFIRM NORTHERN EXTENSION — ANTIMONY BY-PRODUCT CREDIT ADDS CRITICAL MINERAL OVERLAY TO 2.26 MILLION oz Au PROJECT
source_name: Streetwise Reports / Galway Metals Inc. (TSXV: GWM)
snippet: Galway Metals Inc. (TSXV: GWM) released June 10, 2026 results from 34 diamond drill holes at the North Deposit of its 100%-owned Clarence Stream project in New Brunswick — with standout hole ND-61 intersecting 10.85 metres at 5.0 g/t gold (including 2.0m at 11.3 g/t) and hole ND-52 cutting 1.55m at 40.3 g/t gold, expanding the North Deposit's northern extension approximately 430 metres beyond the 2022 mineral resource boundary. Clarence Stream currently hosts 922,000 oz indicated at 2.3 g/t plus 1.334 million oz inferred at 2.6 g/t — and the June 10 results add ounces in resource-unconstrained ground outside the 2022 estimate, pointing toward a material resource update. Streetwise Reports' June 11 analysis highlights a developing antimony by-product opportunity across multiple Clarence Stream drill intercepts: with antimony near $28,000/tonne at multi-year highs driven by China's export restrictions, the critical mineral credit could meaningfully reduce effective gold production costs — adding a dual-commodity overlay to a project whose gold economics are already strong at current prices. For TSXV gold investors, Galway's combination of a 2.26 million oz gold base, systematic northern extension expansion, and an emerging antimony dimension provides the specific geological setup for a value re-rating in the next 12 months.

headline: ROCKY SHORE GOLD ANCHORS BIG BULK ZONE IN NEWFOUNDLAND: 8-FOR-8 HOLES OVER 400m STRIKE — PROGRAM TRIPLES TO 12,500m ON DISCOVERY CONFIRMATION
source_name: Access Newswire / Rocky Shore Gold Ltd. (CSE: RSG)
snippet: Rocky Shore Gold Ltd. (CSE: RSG) announced June 10, 2026 the discovery of a near-surface bulk-style gold zone at its Lane Pond Target within the Gold Anchor Project in central Newfoundland — with gold intersected in all 8 of the first 8 widely spaced reconnaissance holes over 400 metres of strike, 600 metres down-dip, and 50–240 metres vertically, remaining open in all directions. The bulk-style discovery is interpreted to be associated with the Appleton Fault — the same structural corridor that hosts Marathon Gold's Valentine deposit — and prompted an immediate expansion of the drill program from 3,500 metres to 12,500 metres, adding 9,000 metres of systematic follow-up. Gold Anchor covers more than 1,200 square kilometres, making it one of the larger land positions in central Newfoundland's emerging gold district. For CSE-listed junior gold investors, an 8-for-8 first-pass bulk-zone hit over 400m strike in an established Newfoundland discovery corridor is precisely the signal that triggers program expansions and preliminary resource modelling — the recognisable pattern preceding the systematic data collection that converts regional discovery into resource-stage projects.

headline: MITHRIL SILVER AND GOLD COPALQUIN: 4.01 g/t Au AND 225 g/t Ag OVER 7.25m AT TARGET 1 — MEXICO DISTRICT 25,000m PROGRAM BUILDING MULTI-TARGET SILVER-GOLD SYSTEM
source_name: Mexico Mining Center / Mithril Silver and Gold Limited (TSXV: MSG; ASX: MTH)
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold Limited (TSXV: MSG; ASX: MTH) released June 10, 2026 final assay results from Target 1 at the Copalquin Gold-Silver District in Mexico, with hole RE26-013 returning 7.25 metres at 4.01 g/t gold and 225.1 g/t silver, including 0.5 metres at 15.25 g/t gold and 533 g/t silver — confirming a high-energy quartz breccia system approximately 300 metres west of the 2021 Mineral Resource Estimate boundary. The Copalquin District now has a 25,000-metre 2026 drilling program active across multiple targets: Target 1 final results show the known system extends materially beyond the resource boundary; Target 3 drilling has already confirmed high-grade silver-gold mineralization across 700 metres of strike; and additional targets remain undrilled. Earlier 2026 results from the same program included RE26-009 hitting 9.65 metres at 7.00 g/t gold and 370 g/t silver from 271 metres depth. For dual-listed TSXV/ASX silver investors, Mithril's simultaneous multi-target drilling — building a systematic district-scale picture rather than a single-deposit story — is the exploration model that has historically generated the most durable junior silver mining re-ratings, and the current $65+/oz silver price makes the AuEq economics of Copalquin's best intercepts compelling for underground vein development scenarios.

headline: NOA LITHIUM BRINES RUNS TWO RIGS AT ONCE IN SALTA, ARGENTINA — RIO GRANDE PFS TARGETED FOR Q4 2026 AS HYDROGEOLOGICAL DATA COLLECTION ADVANCES
source_name: The Globe and Mail / NOA Lithium Brines Inc. (TSXV: NOAL)
snippet: NOA Lithium Brines Inc. (TSXV: NOAL) provided a June 11, 2026 update confirming both drill rigs are operational at the Rio Grande Project in Salta Province, Argentina: well RT-RG26-PW001 has reached 168 metres and RT-RG26-PW002 is at 30 metres, both on track with the planned exploration program. The hydrogeological data being collected supports completion of a Preliminary Feasibility Study (PFS) by year-end 2026 — positioning Rio Grande among the advancing Argentine lithium brine projects competing for capital in the post-recovery market where CNY 170,000/tonne lithium carbonate ($23,500/t) represents a 70%+ improvement over the 2023–2024 trough. Salta Province brine projects, when they carry lithium grades above 500 mg/L and manageable evaporation pond chemistry, target all-in operating costs well below $10,000/t — substantially lower than Australian hard rock spodumene competitors — making the successful delivery of a 2026 PFS the specific technical milestone that transforms Rio Grande from a resource-stage project into a fundable development asset for battery manufacturers and critical mineral investors.

headline: GOLDSEEK: BEARISH FOMC SETUP CREATES 'EXCEPTIONAL RISK/REWARD' FOR GOLD STOCKS — TECHNICAL ANALYSIS IDENTIFIES $4,150 AS THE LINE IN THE SAND
snippet: A Forex.com technical analysis published this week ahead of the June 16–17 FOMC meeting argues that gold and silver are carrying a bearish near-term bias built around one critical technical level: a weekly close below $4,150 would be the first genuine breakdown signal for gold's bull market structure, with the next support zone at $3,800–$4,000. Silver is identified as the more vulnerable metal heading into the FOMC, given that the gold:silver ratio at 64:1 reflects silver's greater sensitivity to the monetary headwind — but also implies that a dovish FOMC resolution could trigger a silver outperformance move of 2–4x relative to gold on the recovery leg. The analysis provides the technical counterpoint to the consensus bullish GoldSeek and GoldSilver.com frameworks: acknowledging that $4,150 has held through multiple tests, but noting that continued hawkish Fed messaging could force the final speculative long liquidation that breaks it. For retail investors making position sizing decisions ahead of Wednesday's binary, the Forex.com framework translates to a specific risk management rule — $4,150 on a weekly close is the stop-loss level that separates the bull market correction scenario from a more significant retracement toward the $3,800 zone that CPM Group has also identified as a downside risk.

headline: GOLDSEEK: 'THE GREATEST RALLY IN MINING HISTORY BEGINS NOW' — BPI=0, GDX 27% OFF HIGHS, AND RECORD MARGINS ALL ALIGN AT ONCE
snippet: A GoldSeek analysis published this week argues that gold and silver mining stocks are entering the starting gate of what the author describes as the greatest rally in the history of the sector — drawing on the convergence of maximum-fear technical and fundamental conditions not seen simultaneously since the 2015 and 2018 gold mining cycle lows that preceded the most dramatic subsequent recoveries. The three pillars: Gold Miners Bullish Percent Index (BPI) at zero for the first time in the current bull cycle, reflecting total speculative capitulation; GDX at 27% below its March 2026 record high despite gold holding above $4,000 — the largest miner-to-metal divergence of the cycle; and major producers trading at record-low price-to-earnings multiples despite generating record operating cash flow at $2,600+/oz cost-of-sales margins. For TSXV and ASX junior gold investors, the GoldSeek framework provides the contrarian analytical foundation for the positioning debate ahead of Wednesday's FOMC binary: if the GDX:gold divergence begins to close on a dovish Warsh press conference, the initial move in large-cap producers and ETFs typically leads junior miners by 24–48 hours — giving retail investors in TSXV and ASX names a brief but defined window to observe the institutional read before junior equities begin pricing in the cycle change.

headline: GOLDSEEK: JUNIOR MINERS 'ABOUT TO DECOUPLE FROM S&P 500' — NEXT MOVE ANCHORS TO GOLD, NOT EQUITIES, AS CORRELATION BREAKS DOWN
snippet: A GoldSeek market analysis published this week argues that junior gold mining stocks are on the verge of a structural decoupling from the US equity market — where TSXV and ASX-listed juniors stop tracking S&P 500 volatility and instead anchor their price performance to gold's recovery trajectory, independent of whether broader markets continue to advance. The analytical framework identifies the current period as analogous to the 2018–2019 and 2020–2021 transitions, when gold stocks temporarily moved in concert with broad equity selloffs before breaking correlation and staging independent recoveries driven solely by precious metals fundamentals. The conditions for decoupling are identified as more fully present in June 2026 than at any prior point in the current bull cycle: widespread retail capitulation in junior mining combined with continued structural gold demand from central banks, ETFs, and industrial buyers. For investors in TSXV and ASX junior gold explorers, a decoupling scenario — where juniors begin tracking gold recovery while the S&P 500 consolidates through a normal summer cycle — is the direct pathway to the sector outperformance that record operating margins at $4,000+/oz have failed to generate in the correction from January 2026 highs.

headline: GOLDSEEK SEASONAL: SUMMER DOLDRUMS '26 LOOK BULLISH — HISTORY SAYS JUNE WEAKNESS IN GOLD STOCKS SETS UP SEPTEMBER-OCTOBER SURGE
snippet: Adam Hamilton's GoldSeek seasonal analysis of the 2026 gold mining stock summer doldrums argues that the June weakness in GDX and junior gold miners — occurring simultaneously with FOMC uncertainty and the correction from January's $5,589 gold peak — has historically configured the most favourable risk/reward entry window for the subsequent September–October seasonal advance. The analytical framework draws on GDX's seasonal pattern across multiple bull market cycles, identifying that June–July weakness coinciding with a 20%+ correction from prior highs and majority-bearish retail sentiment has consistently resolved into 15–25% GDX recoveries between August and November. The current 2026 summer doldrums setup is characterised as among the most bullish seasonal configurations of the modern gold mining market: the doldrums are occurring at the precise point where fundamental demand drivers (central bank accumulation, de-dollarisation, Iran conflict geopolitical premium) remain intact while the corrective technical picture has not yet broken the primary uptrend. The practical implication for TSXV and ASX junior investors: the next 4–8 weeks of potential summer weakness, if it materialises, represents the historically optimal accumulation window before the fall advance — making dollar-cost averaging through the doldrums the strategy most consistent with capitalising on the seasonal pattern that has repeated with remarkable consistency across three prior gold bull cycles.
